profile.headline: Software Engineer at TDS Telecommunications LLC
profile.summary:
Bilingual IT professional with 14+ years of experience on the implementation, integration, migration, support and maintenance of web-based information systems, including 11+ years in the Technical Leader role and 4+ years as Project Manager.  

Skilled in Unix, Linux and Window Operating Systems, Java, PLSQL, Javascript, SQL, Unix/Linux Shell Scripting, Web Services, Oracle RDBMS, WebLogic 12c, WildFly 10, JBoss 5, Oracle Application Server 10g, Apache HTTP Server, Apache Tomcat, SVN and CVS version control system, among other. 	

Responsible for establishing and maintaining high quality and effective business relationships with customers, defining project plans, managing project risks and coordinating project team work, ensuring on-time completion of tasks and within budget.

Experience providing technical orientation and mentorship to new hires, including creation of technical on-boarding plans. 

1+ years of Software Developer experience architecting and constructing windows and web information systems developed using Genexus Technology.

positions.title: Java Developer-Advanced
positions.description:
•	Technical Leader on the implementation of the WIR-based California Immunization Registry.
   . Responsible for the installation and configuration of the software server architecture (Apache HTTP, Oracle HTTP, WebLogic 12c) and Immunization Registry system software. 
   . Coordinate the work assignments of System Administrators, Database Administrators and Developers.
   . Lead team of developers. Direct the design and architecture of solutions, making sure that these satisfied the customer’s requirements.

•	Analysis, design and constructions of enhancements and modifications for Immunization Information web systems.

positions.title: Ingeniero de Proyectos Informaticos
positions.description: Analyze, architect and construct enhancements and modifications, to the operational and management information systems used by Inter (Venezuelan Telecommunications Company), developed using Genexus technology.

positions.title: Service Information Developer III & IV
positions.description:
• Technical Leader and Project Manager on the implementation and support of three Immunization Information Systems (Iowa, Nebraska and Puerto Rico):
   . Established and maintained a high-quality and effective business relationship with customers, serving as the liaison between the organization and the client. 
   . Responsible for defining project plans, identifying risks and establishing risk mitigation plans.
   . Coordinated the work assignments of System Administrators, Database Administrators, Business Analysts and Developers allocated to projects, ensuring on-time completion of the tasks and within budget.
   . Led teams of developers assigned to projects. Directed the design of solutions, making sure that these satisfied the customer’s requirements.
   . Partnered with third party companies on solutions for the exchange of electronic health information between the IIS and other Health Information Systems.  
   . Responsible for the installation, maintenance, monitoring and troubleshooting of the IIS, including monitoring and troubleshooting the network, hardware, OS, Database and Application Server. 

• Represented the Immunization Solution Services organization at various customer facing events such as: National Immunization Conference, New Mexico customer IIS presentation, Puerto Rico IIS technical training, client consortium meetings.

• Provided introductory technical orientation and mentorship to new hires. Created technical on-boarding plan for new hires.   Part of the interview team for technical positions.

positions.title: Technical Delivery Manager
positions.description:
•	Managed a team of 15 employees.
•	Oversaw project staff allocation and mediated conflict resolution.
•	Handled customer communication and escalations. 
•	Determined hardware and software solutions for the implementation of Immunization Information Systems.

positions.title: Information Analyst
positions.description:
•	Technical Leader on the implementation and support of two Immunization Information Systems (Virginia and Puerto Rico).
•	Analyzed, architected and constructed enhancements and modifications for five different IIS.
•	Led the analysis of requirements and web application development (Struts) of several projects for the Wisconsin Department of Health.

company.name: Aquatic Food Products Lab - University of Florida

positions.title: Ingeniero en Informatica I
positions.description:
•	Developed and managed Information Technology projects for the benefit of the Lara State community. Projects included: Creation of Internet Centers, Development of a DB of Scientists and Researchers for Lara State, Development and Maintenance of a Scientific Web Publication, IT Support to the Chamber of Small and Medium Sized Industries and Artisans.

•	Provided technical support for the staff and ISP customers. Duties included general Windows NT Server administration, ISP customer service, WebPages maintenance, and hardware and software maintenance. Responsible for purchasing all computer hardware and software.

educations.fieldOfStudy: Computer and Information Science and Engineering
